# Qeepl

> > Qeepl is a global luggage storage and self-storage marketplace connecting travelers with secure storage locations in 1000+ cities worldwide.

Qeepl operates in major cities including New York, Los Angeles, Las Vegas, Berlin, Rome, Cancún, Tulum, and Sochi, offering both short-term luggage storage and self-storage rentals. The platform provides multilingual support across 10+ languages with insurance coverage and flexible booking options for tourists and locals.

## Key Topics

- Luggage storage services
- Self-storage rental
- Baggage lockers
- Tourist storage solutions
- Storage locations (1000+ cities)
- Online booking and reservations
- Storage pricing and rates
- Manhattan and Brooklyn locations
- Berlin storage facilities
- Partner program for storage hosts
- Greyhound Bus Station storage
- Insurance and refund policies
- Multi-language support
- City-specific storage guides
